strings.title: DOUBLE_TAKE
strings.subtitle: Problems: missing values and repeated rows
strings.briefing:
The signup form's submit button doesn't disable itself while the request is in flight. Impatient customers double-click. 14 orders exist twice — same customer, same item, same second — and 11 more never captured an email at all.

DOUBLE_TAKE isn't one problem, it's two stacked on the same table. Clear both and it has nothing left to echo.

df is loaded. 180 rows, 5 columns.
strings.task: This order list has two problems: some rows have no customer_email, and some orders were entered twice. Remove the rows with a missing email, then remove the repeated orders (same email, SKU and time).

starterCode.python:
# df is loaded. 180 rows, 5 columns.
# Two afflictions here, not one. Inspect both before you fix either.
df.isna().sum()

python: Two problems here: missing emails and repeated submissions. Handle them one at a time.
df.dropna(subset=['customer_email']) removes rows with no email.
df.drop_duplicates(subset=['customer_email','item_sku','submitted_at']) removes repeats. Assign the result back to df.
sql: Delete rows with no email: DELETE FROM data WHERE customer_email IS NULL;
Duplicates share the same email, SKU and time. Keep the lowest rowid in each group.
DELETE FROM data WHERE rowid NOT IN (SELECT MIN(rowid) FROM data GROUP BY customer_email, item_sku, submitted_at);
